name: Astral Momentum
description: Once per battle, landing a natural 20 with a normal Attack or Moonbeam restores 10 Mana.
activationLines: Astral Momentum activates! Your perfect strike sends Astral energy rushing back through you, restoring 10 Mana.
Astral Momentum activates! Your strike lands perfectly. The Astral Sea apparently approves and refunds you 10 Mana.
Astral Momentum activates! A tiny spark shoots off your foe, circles around, and dives straight back into you. That's 10 Mana back. Apparently it knows where it belongs.
Astral Momentum activates! Your perfect hit leaves behind a trail of starlight that rushes back into you, restoring 10 Mana. Very efficient. Suspiciously efficient.
Astral Momentum activates! Your perfect hit sends a spark of Astral energy bouncing back toward you. It bonks you directly on the forehead and restores 10 Mana. Helpful. Could've aimed better.
fullManaLine: Astral Momentum activates, but your Mana is already full.
